title: Propensity score with factor loadings: evaluating the effect of the Paris Agreement on the returns of European stocks
abstract: arXiv:2507.08764v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Factor models for longitudinal data, where policy adoption is unconfounded with respect to a low-dimensional set of latent factor loadings, have become increasingly popular for causal inference. Most existing approaches, however, rely on a causal finite-sample approach or computationally intensive methods, limiting their applicability and external validity. In this paper, we propose a novel method for panel causal inference within a super-population framework, based on inverse propensity score weighting, where the propensity score is a function of latent factor loadings. The approach relaxes the traditional restrictive assumptions of causal panel methods, while offering advantages in terms of causal interpretability, policy relevance, and computational efficiency. translated_title: 带因子载荷的倾向得分：评估《巴黎协定》对欧洲股票收益的影响
translated_abstract: 基于低维潜在因子载荷集合且政策采纳无混杂的纵向数据因子模型，在因果推断领域日益受到欢迎。然而，大多数现有方法依赖于因果有限样本方法或计算密集型技术，限制了其适用性和外部有效性。本文提出了一种在超总体框架下进行面板因果推断的新方法，该方法基于逆倾向得分加权，其中倾向得分是潜在因子载荷的函数。这一方法放宽了传统因果面板方法的严格假设，同时在因果可解释性、政策相关性和计算效率方面具有优势。在标准假设下，我们为平均处理效应（ATT）开发了一种三步估计程序，并利用M估计理论推导了其大样本性质。模拟结果表明（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一种以潜在因子载荷为函数的逆倾向得分加权新方法，在超总体框架下实现面板因果推断，放宽了传统假设并提升了计算效率，并应用于评估《巴黎协定》对欧洲股票收益的影响。
